description: This PHP source file defines a class CsrfTokenManager that extends Symfony's CsrfTokenManager, providing methods for CSRF token management within the OrangeHRM platform, specifically in the authentication CSRF namespace.

classes.name: CsrfTokenManager
classes.description: A class extending Symfony's CsrfTokenManager to integrate with OrangeHRM's service container and add custom validation logic for CSRF tokens.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CsrfTokenManager by retrieving the token storage from the service container and passing it along with a new TokenGenerator to the parent constructor.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given CSRF token identified by $id and $value is valid by creating a CsrfToken object and delegating validation to the inherited isTokenValid method.
